covered_cases: created, text, function, custom tool and terminal events preserve exact sequence and output indices
thinking and redacted-thinking blocks never leak into answer or diagnostics
implicit text blocks close only after message_stop while explicit unfinished blocks fail closed
message_start and message_delta usage combine with Anthropic cache-read and cache-write accounting
missing message_stop and empty output classify as stream_incomplete
malformed tool JSON and unknown stop reasons classify as protocol_error
side_effects: none; response and message identifiers are injected by the caller
